title: Blue & Gold Celebration and AOL Bridging Ceremony
summary: Our annual Blue and Gold Celebration and Arrow of Light Bridging Ceremony brought the whole pack together with family, district guests, and Scouts BSA troops for songs, skits, awards, and dinner — capped off by our AOL scouts bridging up to Troops 379, 2220, and 2273.

title: Pinewood Derby Success
summary: Despite a last-minute room change and some technical hiccups, our annual Pinewood Derby was a hit thanks to the many parent volunteers who ran weigh-in, graphite application, the start gate, the track, and clean-up. Congratulations to all our scouts on their creativity and sportsmanship!
